correctness.rationale: For a semi-infinite lossless nearest-neighbour lead coupled by J0>0 to a uniformly lossy n-site segment with -i gamma/2, the finite corner resolvent g_n(0)=-i b_n(u)/J obeys b_0=0, b_n=1/(2sinh u+b_{n-1}), u=asinh(gamma/(4J)). Continuants imply b_odd=cosh(nu)/sinh((n+1)u) and b_even=sinh(nu)/cosh((n+1)u). Boundary elimination gives real band-centre reflection r=(1-h²b_n)/(1+h²b_n), h=J0/J, and absorbed fraction 1-r². Odd b decreases from infinity to zero, giving one CPA solution for every h; even log b is strictly concave with unique maximum at u_n, yielding 0/1/2 solutions below/at/above h_c. At maximum log b''(u_n)=-(2n+1), hence R(h_c,u_n+delta)=(2n+1)²delta⁴/16+O(delta⁵). The critical equation implies the stated h_c and gamma_c logarithmic large-even-n expansions. Independently recomputed even critical points for n=2..14 and the exact curvature cancellation; the finite tests corroborate the analytic all-n proof.
